90be328f-1c05-5574-9657-1b0cc04a10b8.content: Specify field and user data sources and analysis procedures corresponding to all HCI research questions.

8a49f598-804e-5a81-8e88-add7b665633a.content: Use a justified minimum-to-maximum target range when confirmations can change, and tie the minimum and maximum to different workload and budget cases.
